author: KEXP
description: Los Angeles band Lucius offer a charming collection of introspective folk-pop on their latest self-titled release. Stringing together melodic harmonies, intricate arrangements, and infectious hooks, the group take to Live on KEXP to share songs off the record, their new single "Hallways" , and more.
title: Lucius performs "Hallways" & more Live on KEXP
